title: When Two or More Board Game
summary: A Christian board game for church youth and young-adult groups, designed to give a group a reason to open up and talk honestly.
blurb: The game exists to make room for vulnerability. It's built on the idea of planting seeds: when you share your faith or something of yourself, you plant something in the people around you, and that may prompt them to open up in turn. Players circle the board through trials, blessings and moments to share, with the ups and downs mimicking the shape of a life rather than a race to a finish line. Board games are a saturated market, so the design leans on nature and a clear primary-colour system to make each space type readable at a glance and keep the tone warm rather than instructional.
